commands.command: deno eval <read-only inherited legacy ticket ID probe>

evidence: An inherited schema-v1 ticket ID reaches an inherited record property and throws instead of returning a stable validation issue.
The complete legacy identity now includes baseRevision and both alternate-base probes are rejected.
Mixed protected and ordinary write scope now validates against exactly the protected authorization subset.
The correction uses bounded string and hash checks and does not add subprocess or blob consumption.
The fixes and v2 fixture migration remain localized and the clean diff passes whitespace checks.
The frozen 44-case regression passes, but a valid Deno global option before eval remains an uncovered trivial-success bypass.

findings.expectedBehavior: All Deno eval task forms, including forms with executable-global options before eval, are rejected as trivial ticket gates.
findings.observedBehavior: The predicate requires eval immediately after deno; deno --quiet eval false exits zero and validates without task_definition_noop.
findings.reproduction: Run deno --quiet eval false and a revision-bound task fixture using the same definition; both exit zero and the validator returns no issue.
findings.impact: A required task can still be changed into a trivial-success gate while appearing independently guarded.
findings.requiredRemediation: Parse the bounded Deno command prefix sufficiently to detect eval after supported global options, or positively restrict accepted task command shapes.
findings.verification: Add regressions for --quiet, --config, and combined global options before eval while retaining legitimate deno check/test/run tasks.

findings.expectedBehavior: Every string ticket ID is handled as data and returns structured validation issues without throwing.
findings.observedBehavior: Inherited names such as toString pass the inherited-property check and then throw because the inherited value is not a digest set.
findings.reproduction: Validate a schema-v1 bundle whose ticketId is toString; direct validation throws TypeError and the directory validator collapses it to io_error.
findings.impact: Malformed untrusted ticket metadata can crash the structural API and obscure the real diagnostic.
findings.requiredRemediation: Use an own-property-safe lookup, Map, or null-prototype record for legacy digest admission.
findings.verification: Add inherited-name cases such as toString, constructor, and __proto__; each must return a stable schema/legacy diagnostic without throwing.

notes: AUTONOMY-001-R1-ARCH-001 and AUTONOMY-001-R1-SEC-002 are resolved by this candidate.
The clean candidate passed the controller's 183-test exact-coverage and PostgreSQL 18.4/17.10 gates.
